questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion/s logically and definitely follow/s from the given statements.

**Statements:** All Shoes are Feet. Some Shoes are Boxes. All Boxes are Houses.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some Houses are Shoes.

(II) Some Feet are Boxes.

options.text: Both conclusions (I) and (II) do not follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9dd5aa543aa8fd0050db6e8755329b509734a8a7e392a13be24fe09606fb4ebd.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some Houses are Shoes → Follow (As, some Shoes are Boxes and all Boxes are Houses, So, all boxes comes in houses and has some part common with shoes therefore it is definitely true.)

II. Some Feet are Boxes → Follow (As, all Shoes are Feet and some Shoes are Boxes. So, all shoes comes in feet and has some part common with boxes therefore it is definitely true.)

Here, Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow**".
